The Timeline

What Happens to SGLI After You Separate

These dates are summarized from VA guidance. Program details can change, so confirm them at va.gov before you decide.

120 days

SGLI Keeps Going for 120 Days

Your SGLI coverage generally continues for 120 days after separation at no cost. After that it ends unless you have converted it or replaced it.

240 days

VGLI With No Health Questions

If you apply for Veterans' Group Life Insurance within 240 days of separating, you generally do not have to answer health questions.

1 year + 120 days

The Final VGLI Deadline

You can still apply up to 1 year and 120 days after separating, but health questions apply after day 240. VGLI coverage cannot exceed the SGLI amount you had when you separated.

Compare

VGLI or Private Coverage? Look at Both

Neither choice is right for everyone. Many veterans keep VGLI, some replace it, and some combine the two.

📈

How VGLI Is Priced

VGLI premiums are set by age group and go up as you get older. Its biggest advantage is the no-health-questions window.

🧮

How Private Coverage Differs

A private term or whole life policy is priced on your age and health when you apply. For some healthy veterans, a level-premium term policy can cost less over time. For others, VGLI is the better deal.

👪

Your Spouse's Coverage

Family SGLI coverage for a spouse generally ends after separation. Spouses usually need their own policy, and we can quote one alongside yours.

A Simple Checklist

Before You Decide

  1. Write down your separation date and mark day 120 and day 240 on a calendar.
  2. Check your current SGLI amount and whether you have Family SGLI for your spouse.
  3. Get a VGLI premium estimate for your age from va.gov.
  4. Get a private quote for the same coverage amount, so you compare like with like.
  5. If you are unsure about your health questions, apply for VGLI inside the 240-day window first. You can always add or replace coverage later; you cannot get the no-health-questions window back.

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Should I convert SGLI to VGLI?

It depends on your health, budget and family. VGLI's big advantage is that you can get it with no health questions if you apply within 240 days of separation. We can show you a private quote next to it so you can compare.

What happens to my life insurance when I leave the military?

SGLI generally continues for 120 days after separation at no cost, then ends. You can convert to VGLI, buy private coverage, or both.

Can I have both VGLI and private coverage?

Yes. Some veterans keep VGLI and add a private policy, or keep VGLI until private coverage is approved and in force.

Does my spouse's coverage end when I separate?

Family SGLI coverage for a spouse generally ends after separation. Check va.gov for the current rules and conversion options, and ask us for a quote for your spouse.

Are you part of the Army or the VA?

No. We are an independent, family-owned insurance agency licensed in Oklahoma and Missouri. We are not affiliated with the Army, the Department of Defense, or the VA.
